info.title: Platform API
info.description: Job Tracker, Health Monitor, and Auth. See docs/api.md for the human-authored source of truth (ADR-011).

bearerAuth.description: Reads: optional — absent -> guest (read-only demo data); present and valid -> the caller's own data. Writes (POST/PATCH/DELETE) and the /auth/me routes require a valid token; a guest gets 401 `Authentication required` before body validation. A present-but-invalid token always 401s `Invalid or expired token` (never silently downgraded to guest).

details.description: Present for 400s: Zod's flattened field-error map (object-wide issues under `_errors`). Omitted for 401/404/500.

RegisterRequest.description: username: 3-32 characters (letters, digits, `_`, `-`), unique case-insensitively; password: 8-128 characters.

SetPasswordRequest.description: Gives a Google-only account its first password; `username` optionally replaces the generated one.

GoogleLinkRequest.description: Frontend page the browser returns to after linking (must pass the origin allowlist).

url.description: Google's consent URL; navigate the browser to it

GoogleLinkCompleteRequest.description: The link ticket from the callback fragment `#link_ticket=<ticket>` (URL-decoded). Valid for 5 minutes and only for the user who started the link.

CreateJobApplicationRequest.description: status defaults to SAVED, currency defaults to USD when omitted.

UpdateJobApplicationRequest.description: Partial update — all fields optional, but at least one is required.

CreateGlucoseRequest.description: Exactly one of fastingValue/afterMealValue must be provided.

UpdateGlucoseRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

CreateBloodPressureRequest.description: systolic must be greater than diastolic.

UpdateBloodPressureRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

UpdateWeightRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

CreateSymptomRequest.description: Create a symptom entry. intensity is 1-10.

UpdateSymptomRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

post.summary: Start linking a Google account to the current user
post.description: Step 1 of 2. POST with a JSON body because a browser navigation cannot carry the Authorization header. The frontend navigates the browser to the returned `url`; the callback then redirects to `<redirect>#link_ticket=<ticket>` without linking anything, and the frontend finishes with `POST /auth/google/link/complete`.

400.description: Validation error, or `redirect must be an allowed frontend URL`

401.description: No token (guest) -> `Authentication required`, returned before body validation; invalid or expired token -> `Invalid or expired token`

post.summary: Finish linking a Google account with the link ticket
post.description: Step 2 of 2. Links the Google account named in the ticket to the caller, only if the caller is the user who started the link. A ticket of another user is rejected exactly like an invalid one.

200.description: Google account linked; the updated user

400.description: Validation error, or `Invalid or expired link ticket` (malformed, tampered, expired, or issued for another user)

401.description: No token (guest) -> `Authentication required`, returned before body validation; invalid or expired token -> `Invalid or expired token`

409.description: `Google account is already used by another user`, or `Google account is already linked`

get.description: Scope `openid` only. `redirect` must be an allowed frontend URL (exact origin match, or localhost/127.0.0.1 on any port; http/https; no `#`).

302.description: Redirects to Google's consent screen with a signed, short-lived `state` that carries the validated redirect

400.description: `redirect must be an allowed frontend URL` (missing or not allowlisted; no redirect is made)

get.summary: Complete Google Sign-In or account linking
get.description: Always answers with a redirect to the frontend, carrying the result in the URL fragment: `#token=<jwt>` (sign-in), `#link_ticket=<ticket>` (link flow — nothing is linked yet; redeem it with `POST /auth/google/link/complete`), `#error=access_denied` (user cancelled), `#error=google_failed`.

401.description: `Invalid or expired state` — missing, invalid, expired, or not issued by this server (the redirect target is unknown, so no redirect is made)
